_derived.note: Composed for the tests, not recorded: no credentials for a live mailbox were used. Addresses are under example.org/.com/.net/evil.example (RFC 2606). The .eml files were written by Python's email.header (RFC 2047 encoded words, quoted-printable, base64), so the encodings are what a mail client produces. inbox-5 carries a display name built to look like an address, the shape of the nodemailer addressparser advisories of October 2026 (GHSA-8c8m-p3m8-cjg8).
